scene_target: The party emerges onto the Outpost Surface and is immediately caught in a violent, physical storm of refunded XP and loot.
goal: Survive the concussive impact of the System's violent refund.
conflict: The sheer physical mass and velocity of the back-paid rewards threaten to crush the party, who are already at critical health and stamina.
required_callbacks: The sky turning a violent, glitching purple as the audit processes.
constraints: Maintain high mechanical specificity regarding the physical nature of the XP and loot.
end_condition: The party is trapped in the dangerous storm of refunded System value, struggling under its weight.
transition_in_text: The party bursts from the collapsing access shaft onto the Outpost Surface just as the sky glitches into a violent purple and the refund begins.
transition_out_text: The physical weight and concussive force of the XP and loot begin to crush them, demanding immediate allocation to survive.

last_scene: The party burst from the collapsing access shaft onto the Outpost Surface.
The sky glitched into a violent purple as the System began processing the 14.3% withheld value.
XP and loot rained down as dangerous physical objects, cratering the surface.
Vance blocked a crystallized XP shard with his Rebar, taking concussive damage that dropped his HP to 2.
The party was trapped under the crushing physical weight of the unallocated rewards.
